# Producer-side lang go emission (T-Sec5). A Go package compiled for
# wasm carries __.LOGOS with one lang go record and per-function facts
# only, and no declaration header.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm

cd g
go tool compile -p example.com/g -o $WORK/g.a g.go
go tool pack p $WORK/g.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^logos-facts 3$'
stdout '^fingerprint [0-9a-f]{16}$'
stdout '^lang go$'
stdout '^fn '
! stdout '^opt '
! stdout '^const '
! stdout '^prop '
! stdout '^comptime '

-- g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- g/g.go --
package g

func F(x int) int { return x }
